pinnacle_pinv.title: PINNacle: Poisson coefficient recovery (PInv)
metrics: Reported relative L2 error (lower is better)
pinnacle_pinv.setting: PInv on [0,1]^2. 2,500 solution observations on a 50 x 50 grid. Gaussian noise is written N(0,0.1) in the paper. Preserve that notation without inferring a standard-deviation convention.
pinnacle_pinv.evaluation: Mean and standard deviation over three runs. 20,000 optimization epochs. The paper labels the error L2RE.
pinnacle_pinv.timing: Table 14 gives the mean runtime for per-instance optimization. This is online solution cost, not reusable offline pretraining and not a single network forward pass.
pinnacle_pinv.hardware: Section 4.1 reports a server with 20 Intel Xeon Silver 4210 CPUs and eight RTX 2080 Ti GPUs. Per-run GPU allocation is not specified. The paper describes 12 GB per GPU. This hardware description is retained as reported, not independently verified.
pinnacle_pinv.selection: Vanilla PINN, boundary-weighted PINN, gradient-enhanced PINN, and the variational method labelled vPINN in the source.

pinnacle_hinv.title: PINNacle: diffusion coefficient recovery (HInv)
metrics: Reported relative L2 error (lower is better)
pinnacle_hinv.setting: HInv on [-1,1]^2 x [0,1]. 2,500 random space-time observations. Gaussian noise written N(0,0.1).
pinnacle_hinv.evaluation: Same four method labels as PInv. Mean and standard deviation over three runs with 20,000 optimization epochs.
pinnacle_hinv.selection: Retains the same method set as PInv to show task dependence, including unsuccessful high-error results.

cindm_one.title: CinDM: one-airfoil design
cindm_one.setting: One-airfoil design. Models trained on flow around a single shape at 64 x 64 resolution. Designs evaluated with Lily-Pad at 128 x 128 resolution.
cindm_one.evaluation: Appendix D.1: 10 batches, 20 candidates per batch. Select the best design in each batch, then average across 10 batches. Table 3 gives means without uncertainty intervals.
cindm_one.timing: No task-matched wall-clock training or design times identified in Table 3 and Appendix D.1. N-body training times in Appendix A must not be reused for airfoils.
cindm_one.selection: All five methods in Table 3. Both metrics are retained because their rankings differ.

cindm_two.title: CinDM: two-airfoil design
cindm_two.setting: Compositional generalization to two airfoils after training on single-shape flows. Training 64 x 64, Lily-Pad evaluation 128 x 128.
cindm_two.evaluation: Best of 20 per batch, averaged across 10 batches, as in one-airfoil design. Do not interpret as mean performance of all generated candidates.

burgers_pofc.title: DiffPhyCon: 1D Burgers, partial observation and full control (PO-FC)
metrics: Best reported terminal control error J_actual (lower is better)
burgers_pofc.setting: Only PO-FC entries from Table 1. Do not combine with FO-PC or PO-PC. Control error is evaluated with the ground-truth dynamics.
burgers_pofc.evaluation: Table 1 reports best J_actual. The control-energy budget is not fixed across these reported minima. Physical actuation energy is not computational cost.
burgers_pofc.timing: Appendix K.4 identifies PO-FC as the timed setting and reports average inference time over test samples. Performance and timing are matched by method and task. Exact checkpoints and guidance settings are not cross-indexed between Tables 1 and 23, so these are reported summaries, not a measured fixed-budget Pareto frontier.
burgers_pofc.hardware: Online times: one Tesla V100 GPU and eight CPUs. Offline hardware varies by method and is stored per row.
burgers_pofc.selection: BC, BPPO, DiffPhyCon-lite and DiffPhyCon in the main table. SL is included in the supplement. SAC timings are excluded because Table 23 does not identify which SAC variant in Table 1 was timed. DDIM has a separate timing-only record with no borrowed accuracy.

pdeinv_ns_compute.title: PDEInvBench: 2D unforced Navier-Stokes compute profile
pdeinv_ns_compute.setting: Compute profiles in Table 4. Appendix C.1.2 reports batch size 32 and 200 training epochs.
pdeinv_ns_compute.evaluation: No accuracy is attached to these cost rows. Table 4 does not cross-index an accuracy operating point.
pdeinv_ns_compute.timing: Inference is reported in iterations per second per batch. Preserve it/s. It is not per-instance latency, and no serial latency is inferred by dividing by batch size.
pdeinv_ns_compute.hardware: Appendix C.1.3 calls the device NVIDIA RTX A100. This nonstandard label is quoted as reported. Exact device identity and memory capacity are unresolved.
pdeinv_ns_compute.selection: All three architectures in Table 4 for 2DNS.

pdeinv_darcy_compute.title: PDEInvBench: Darcy flow compute profile
pdeinv_darcy_compute.setting: 2DDF rows in Table 4. General protocol: batch size 32, 200 epochs.
pdeinv_darcy_compute.evaluation: Cost-only records. No accuracy or split is inferred from other figures.
pdeinv_darcy_compute.timing: Training durations preserved in minutes. Inference throughput preserved in it/s per batch.
pdeinv_darcy_compute.hardware: Source reports NVIDIA RTX A100, with unresolved device naming.
pdeinv_darcy_compute.selection: All three architectures in Table 4 for 2DDF.
